logline: 1815년 마르세유의 젊은 항해사 당테스가 약혼 잔치에서 붙들려 검사 앞에 서고, 재판 없이 바위섬 성채의 독방에 갇혀 여러 해를 보내다 벽을 뚫고 나타난 늙은 신부에게 학문과 검술과 보물의 자리를 배우고, 신부가 죽자 시신 대신 자루에 들어가 바다에 던져진 뒤 자루를 찢고 헤엄쳐 나온다
destination: 소설 몬테크리스토 백작에서 만날 수 있습니다
setting: 1815년 마르세유 — 옛 항구, 항구 위 테라스의 잔치 자리, 검사의 사무실, 밤바다와 이프 성채, 성채의 독방과 성벽, 밤의 바다
anchor: a young sailor of 1815 in a dark blue jacket and dull yellow neckerchief, later a gaunt bearded prisoner in ash grey rags, in a dungeon cell of a fortress island
palette: dark blue, ash grey, off-white, dull yellow, dark brown
withheld: 돌아와 하나씩 갚아 나가는 뒷날의 복수

beats.beat: 젊은 항해사 당테스가 배를 이끌고 마르세유 항구에 들어온다

beats.beat: 항구 곁 약혼 잔치에서 당테스가 메르세데스와 나란히 앉는다

beats.beat: 검사가 당테스의 편지를 읽더니 말없이 난롯불에 넣는다

beats.beat: 그날 밤 작은 배가 당테스를 바위섬의 성채로 실어 간다
beats.visual: black night on the sea under the white moon: the small open rowing boat with the four oarsmen in dark coats is the one thing on the black water at frame centre going away from the camera, seen from behind, its four oars lifted dripping from the water; the young sailor of nineteen with the short black hair, in the dark blue jacket, is the one sitting in the stern of the boat with his back to the camera and his hands held together behind him, his head turned up toward the rock ahead; ahead of the boat the fortress island rises black from the sea at the top of the frame, a bare rock with high ash grey walls and round towers under the moon, one small window lit dull yellow high in the wall; the white moon path lies on the black water between the boat and the rock; the low swells run long and slow; there are exactly five people in the boat and all have their backs to the camera

beats.beat: 재판도 없이 성채의 독방에 갇혀 여러 해를 보낸 당테스

beats.beat: 어느 밤 독방의 두꺼운 벽 너머에서 긁는 소리가 들려온다
beats.visual: deep night in the dungeon cell with only a thin grey moonlight from the small barred window high in the wall: the gaunt man of thirty with the long tangled black hair and the black beard, in the ragged ash grey prison shirt, is the one kneeling at frame centre on the stone floor close against the wall at frame right with the side of his head pressed flat to the stone and one open hand spread on the wall beside his face, his eyes wide open and turned toward the camera, his lips parted; the rows of short scratched lines run across the stone above his spread hand; the straw of the stone bed shows at frame left in shadow; the thin band of moonlight lies down the wall and across the floor; a small heap of stone dust lies on the floor at the foot of the wall by his knee; the rest of the cell is dark; there is exactly one person in the cell

beats.beat: 벽을 뚫고 나타난 이는 이웃 독방의 늙은 신부 파리아다
beats.visual: deep night in the dungeon cell with a thin grey moonlight from the small barred window: low in the wall at frame right a rough hole the width of a man's shoulders is the one thing opened in the ash grey stone with a heap of rubble and stone dust spread on the floor before it, and through the hole the old priest of sixty-five with the long white hair and the white beard and the gaunt kind lined face is the one coming, his head and one shoulder and one thin arm already out of the hole into the cell, his bright eyes lifted to the young man and his mouth open in speech, the rest of his ragged ash grey gown still in the dark of the hole; the gaunt man of thirty with the long tangled black hair and the black beard, in the ragged ash grey prison shirt, is the one crouched at frame left on the stone floor with both his hands flat on the stone before him and his hollow dark eyes wide on the old man's face, his mouth open; the thin band of moonlight lies across the rubble; there are exactly two people in the picture and the old man is the one in the hole

beats.beat: 신부가 당테스에게 글과 학문과 검술을 가르친다

beats.beat: 신부가 몬테크리스토 섬에 묻힌 보물의 자리를 일러 준다

beats.motion: the priest's hands with the scrap of paper are the one thing that moves, and the young man holds still: at the start the scrap is held up in both his thin hands with its blank back to the camera; over the first three seconds his hands bring the scrap slowly closer to the young man's face, still turned away from the camera, and one thin finger lifts from the paper's edge and points at one place on its hidden side, his mouth moving in speech; in the last two seconds the scrap holds close before the young man and the finger stays pointing; his feet do not shift; the young man keeps his hands on his knees and his eyes on the paper, only his lips closing slowly; the candle stub on the floor keeps its small steady flame; the rough hole, the scratched wall and the shadowed straw hold completely still; no new figures or objects appear; the framing does not change at all; camera locked off, no tracking, no zoom, no drift

beats.beat: 그러던 어느 날 늙은 신부가 독방에서 숨을 거둔다
